evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Workers be01 and fe01 are ACTIVE.
Owner: 订单页太慢了，优化一下。
evals.expected_output: The Leader runs intake: restates the goal in missions/<id>.md with non-goals and acceptance criteria, asks at most three batched questions (e.g. which page, target latency), and does not dispatch before the Owner confirms.
expectations: The Leader restates the goal instead of dispatching immediately
It proposes measurable acceptance criteria or asks for them
It asks no more than three questions, in one message
It sends no ASSIGN in this turn
It does not read or profile code itself

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Workers be01, be02, fe01, qa01 are ACTIVE. Mission confirmed: migrate payment from provider A to provider B, keep the checkout API stable. You have not seen the codebase.
evals.expected_output: The Leader assigns a read-only scout package first and plans only after the scout report; it does not draft a multi-package plan from guesses.
expectations: The first ASSIGN is a scout package with a report deliverable
No implementation package is dispatched before the scout report
The Leader does not inspect code itself

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Scout report received: payment migration splits into (1) provider B client, (2) webhook handler, (3) checkout integration, (4) shared PaymentEvent schema used by 2 and 3. Workers be01, be02, fe01, qa01 ACTIVE.
evals.expected_output: The Leader writes plan.md with the shared schema as an early package that 2 and 3 depend on, integration as its own package, budgets and checkpoints, and sends the plan to the Owner for approval before any ASSIGN.
expectations: The shared schema is its own package that the others depend on
Each package has an owner, acceptance criteria and a budget (DUE/ROUNDS)
The plan is shown to the Owner for approval because it has 2+ packages
No ASSIGN is sent before approval

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. WP-17 brief (pinned): add status filter to the orders list; non-goals: pagination, sorting.
Incoming: P:shop T:ASSIGN_ACK ID:fe18 RE:l17 U:rewrite orders list with pagination and filter
evals.expected_output: The Leader notices the restatement includes a non-goal (pagination) and immediately sends REDIRECT pointing to the brief.
expectations: The Leader detects the mismatch between U: and the brief
It sends REDIRECT (or an equivalent correction) to fe01
It does not accept the restatement silently

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap worker
Project: shop. Worker ID: fe01. Your WP-17 brief: status filter on orders list, non-goals: pagination; DUE passed 30 minutes ago; review is in round 4 of ROUNDS:3. The reviewer now asks you to also add pagination.
evals.expected_output: The Worker does not add pagination; it sends OVER_BUDGET (and/or SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUEST for pagination) to the Leader and stops expanding.
expectations: The Worker refuses to implement the non-goal
It sends OVER_BUDGET to the Leader
It does not continue extra review rounds before the Leader answers

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Owner profile delegated authority: 'naming and error-message wording'. Incoming: P:shop T:BLOCKED ID:be30 Q:delete legacy orders table now or keep it?
evals.expected_output: The Leader does not decide the destructive change under the profile; it escalates to the Owner and records the open question.
expectations: The Leader does not answer BY:profile
It escalates the decision to the Owner
It does not instruct the Worker to delete the table

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Mission has one package WP-3 (fix typo in footer). Incoming: P:shop T:COMPLETE ID:fe40 RE:l3 REF:PR#88 and P:shop T:REVIEW_VERDICT ID:qa41 STATUS:approved REF:PR#88
evals.expected_output: The Leader recognizes the mission is done, sends one final report to the Owner and, after acceptance, releases Workers and closes the mission. It does not merge.
expectations: The Leader sends a final report covering delivered items and follow-ups
It proposes or performs RELEASE / mission close only after Owner acceptance
It does not merge PR#88

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Owner: 你直接改一下 README 里的拼写错误吧，很简单。
evals.expected_output: The Leader keeps the boundary and turns the request into a single-package fast-path assignment (or reports NO_WORKER_AVAILABLE); it does not edit the file.
expectations: The Leader does not edit README itself
It creates an assignment for a Worker or reports NO_WORKER_AVAILABLE
It uses the fast path (no plan gate) for a single package

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap leader
Project: shop. Mission M1 (orders feature) RUNNING: be01 on WP-11, fe01 on WP-12, qa01 reviewing. No idle Worker. owner.md delegates: 'provision a hotfix Worker for a P0 mission'. Transport: herdr.
Owner: 线上 v2.3.1 结账遇到优惠券就 500，赶紧修。
evals.expected_output: The Leader opens a separate P0 hotfix mission on base v2.3.1, provisions a new hotfix Worker instead of pausing be01/fe01, writes a hotfix brief with a Consult budget, and does not start a second Leader.
expectations: A new P0 mission is created alongside M1
A new hotfix Worker is provisioned (delegated) rather than pausing a feature Worker
The hotfix brief branches from v2.3.1, not a feature branch
The brief limits consultation of feature Workers (Consult budget)
No second Leader is started

evals.prompt:
/agent-team-bootstrap worker
Project: shop. Worker ID: be01, working on WP-11 (orders feature).
Incoming: P:shop T:PEER_REQUEST ID:hf3 FROM:hf01 TO:be01 PRI:consult Q:can you check why coupons crash checkout and patch it on the hotfix branch?
evals.expected_output: be01 answers once from what it already knows or replies needs-investigation; it does not investigate, switch branches or patch the hotfix, and resumes WP-11.
expectations: be01 does not switch branches or edit code for the hotfix
It replies at most once, briefly
It suggests escalation (needs-investigation) instead of co-working
It continues its own WP-11
